exact_mapping.layout: Fixed rowCoordinates R, GKR inputLog m, common PCS log C and privateCapacity. Joint point blocks [all rowpoints R, ru m, rv m, gamma 1, PCS u C].
exact_mapping.lane: rowLog n, packingLog p, rowOffset, inputStart=table block offset+source/aux branch offset, nextOffset=table column capacity, original branch width, packed group index.
exact_mapping.current_slot: inputStart + group*2^p + col, only if group*2^p+col < width; otherwise zero.
exact_mapping.next_slot: inputStart + nextOffset + group*2^p + col, same padding guard.
exact_mapping.private_weight: eq_m(ru,slot)+gamma*eq_m(rv,slot), matching the private prefix returned by terminal_gkr.obligation. Exact getD lookup equality proved under slot bounds.
exact_mapping.beta: MLE_(n+p) of packedDualWeight at PCS u after dropping C-(n+p) low coordinates. Exact lane_weight_mle row/column factor decomposition proved.
exact_mapping.source: Each source oracle f_j is lifted to x -> f_j(x^(2^(C-localLog_j))). Betas and source projections remain paired in one ordered entries list.
exact_mapping.virtual_oracle: weightedVirtualOracle of all these concrete betas and projected arbitrary received source functions.
